structure.layout: desktop web app with Office-style ribbon toolbar (File/Home/Edit/Account tabs, grouped icon buttons) above a grey content region showing a start page: title + tagline, then a two-column grid of link lists (Recent, Help, New Feature, News)

aesthetics.typography: 'Chinese Quote' (Ant Design system stack, renders as Helvetica/Arial-like sans) for ribbon labels (11px), tab labels, section labels (20px) and links (14px); Segoe UI (falling back to Open Sans-like) for the start page title (30px/400) and tagline (24px/300)
aesthetics.typeScale: Small, low-contrast hierarchy: 30px regular title, 24px light tagline, 20px section labels, 14px blue links, 11px ribbon button labels, 10px ribbon group captions

notes: Directly mimics the Microsoft Office ribbon: solid blue FILE button (#0072c6) leading a tab strip, large icon buttons with 11px captions grouped by grey caption bars (Table/Export/Page/Feedback), and a FILE backstage (seen live) with a dark-blue left nav column. Ribbon is white on a grey #f1f1f1 work area. The 'New' word in 'New Feature' is highlighted with a solid blue (#1890ff) background block. Emoji used in the tagline (three sunglasses faces). Orange GitHub-octocat-like avatar beside the user name. No rounded corners, no shadows. Links use Ant Design blue #1890ff. Live page fired a 'Data not found' toast on load that is not in the capture.
